checkpoints.description: [1/4] Plan: pure rule-path confidence/uncertainty readout from BFS move ties

impact_assessment.why: The probe carries dead-pool/cycle facts but no statement of how ambiguous the rule action is. A pure readout of the number of equally best free moves gives per-step planning confidence without changing the action.
impact_assessment.benefits: probe.rule carries goal/distance/ties/confidence/rule_distance/optimal; unique moves score 1.0, two-way ties 0.5; rule_readout=False removes the field; actions/steps/rewards are identical; the readout is auditable in telemetry and can be aggregated across seeds.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Planner rule_readout keyword and policy key (digest changes); dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: no schema change; telemetry probe grows by one field.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Compute the readout only for a resolved goal; keep it pure and side-effect-free; compare on/off actions across unit states and pin seeds; test unique/tie/collect/off/no-goal/invalid/policy; rerun 322 tests and AIKit.

[1/4] Plan: archive-based calibration-journal rotation with backup and lossless combined loading

impact_assessment.why: The calibration forecast journal grows one checksummed line per forecast and has no retention. Rotation can bound the live file to the newest N records while archiving older records and preserving every score, unlike pruning which would discard evidence.
impact_assessment.benefits: rotate_forecast_journal moves older records to .archive, keeps the newest N live, backs the pre-rotation journal up as .bak, and records source/archive counts in a .rotation sidecar; load_all_forecasts combines archive+live with unique ids and the same Brier/skill; missing/short journals are no-ops.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new calibration_store rotation/load-all APIs only, append/load/verify unchanged; dependency: stdlib shutil; concurrency: rotation holds the existing writer lock; state: new .archive/.bak/.rotation files, local only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate every record and keep archives idempotent by id; write archive/live atomically; back up the live journal before replacement; test split, score preservation, second rotation, conflict, no-op, missing, corrupt, stale/fresh lock, and rerun 334 tests plus AIKit.

[1/4] Plan: opt-in automatic calibration retention after a logged-run forecast append

impact_assessment.why: The bridge appends every run's forecasts and relies on a separate manual rotation. A logged run with calibration_keep_recent can bound the live journal immediately after its append by reusing the tested archive rotation, without changing actions or scores.
impact_assessment.benefits: run_task_logged(calibration_path=..., calibration_keep_recent=10) appends then rotates; T3:15 leaves 10 live/3 archive/13 total with the same Brier 0.230769; a second run reaches 10 live/9 archive/19 total with 0.223684; no threshold keeps 13 live; invalid/no-path/corrupt-archive cases fail loudly.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: run_task_logged calibration_keep_recent keyword only, append/rotate APIs unchanged; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: append and rotation each take the store lock; state: automatic .archive/.bak/.rotation files, opt-in.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate the threshold before the run; append first, then rotate, so a rotation failure leaves all forecasts live and the verdict intact; test single/two-run/no-threshold/no-path/invalid/corrupt/action parity; rerun 343 tests and AIKit.

[1/4] Plan: atomic append+retention threshold in the calibration store

impact_assessment.why: The cycle-81 bridge appends forecasts and then calls rotate_forecast_journal as two lock acquisitions. append_forecasts(keep_recent=...) can append and rotate under one store lock, closing the ADR-075 atomicity boundary and making retention available to every caller.
impact_assessment.benefits: One append call with keep_recent rotates to live N/archive rest/total unchanged, preserves Brier/skill, creates the backup/rotation metadata, and reports rotated/live/archived; the bridge passes its threshold through instead of a second lock; None keeps all live; a corrupt archive fails after the append with every new forecast live.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: append_forecasts gains keep_recent only, rotate/load APIs unchanged; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: one lock covers append+rotation; state: automatic .archive/.bak/.rotation files, opt-in.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Extract the locked rotation core, keep rotate_forecast_journal as the manual wrapper, validate the threshold before writing, test store-level single/second/corrupt/invalid/noop cases plus the bridge suite, and rerun 351 tests and AIKit.
